entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' or 'Sales' to be routed to the correct department.
SUPPORT!
Connecting you to a VeloFit support agent now.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this useless VeloBand tracker. Now.
I can certainly look into the return options for you. I just need to pull up your account. Can I get your name and email address, please?
It's Mark Peterson. M-A-R-K. The email is markpete@email.com. Now hurry up, I don't have all day.

Thank you, Mark. I'm pulling that up now... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand GPS Tracker, delivered on December 22nd. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

It doesn't matter what the issue is! I don't want it. I've had it for almost a month and I'm done with it. I want my money back. I know you're probably going to say it's too late, but let me tell you, if you don't process this refund I am going to light up your company on every review site and social media platform I can find. You'll regret it.
I understand your frustration, Mark, and I'm sorry you're not satisfied with the product. Let me just take a moment to review the return policy for your specific item.
Just get me your manager. This is ridiculous. The policy should be 'the customer is always right'.

I can definitely handle this for you, sir. And actually, I have some good news. I've confirmed your VeloBand GPS Tracker falls under our standard 90-day return policy. Since you're only on day 28, you are well within the timeframe. I can approve this return for you immediately.
Oh. Ninety days? I thought for sure you were going to tell me it was too late because of some sanitation or hygiene rule.

Not for this model. We stand by our standard products, and the 90-day policy is firm. I'm generating a pre-paid return shipping label for you now. I've just sent it to the email on file. Do you see it?
Hold on... yeah, it just came through. So I just print this and send the thing back?

That's correct. Just pack the VeloBand and its accessories in the original box if possible, attach the label, and drop it at any post office. As soon as our warehouse receives it, a full refund will be issued back to your original payment method. That usually takes 3 to 5 business days.
Huh. Okay. Well... that was easier than I expected. Sorry for getting heated.
It's no problem at all, Mark. I'm glad I could get this sorted out for you quickly. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thanks, Alex.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
